provenance.title: Door sizes
provenance.covers: Common door widths and heights, and how close to a wall an opening must be to count as on it. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.
